entities.name: Arawak Settlement and Agricultural Communities
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Arawak people migrated to Saint Lucia from South America via the island chain, establishing fishing and agricultural communities. They called the island Iouanalao ('island of the iguanas') and left archaeological evidence at multiple sites across the island.
